title: Bruch-Quest
brief: Modernes, originales Blockwelt-Abenteuer für den deutschen Bruchunterricht der Klasse 6: richtige Antworten bewegen eine artikulierte Figur, sammeln Beute und lösen kurze Kampfsequenzen aus.

artboards.title: Quest trail
artboards.tradeoff: Immersive live world makes answer-driven movement tangible; the task panel stays beside the active stage on desktop and stacks on mobile.

artboards.title: Inventory cards
artboards.tradeoff: Makes individual learning cards and rewards tangible; less dramatic for hard challenges.

artboards.title: Boss arena
artboards.tradeoff: High motivational energy for difficult operations; unsuitable as the default entry screen.
